comment: She really likes to talk, but is usually funny. The project takes a lot of time and the final exam is kind of difficult. Overall a decent professor.

Torres is fine if you need the credit. The project takes up a lot of time even though it's super minuscule for your grade. She's not good at grading assignments on time and her lectures are quite empty. Honestly, I could have learned the content of the class from AI.

She is so extremely disorganized it's not even funny. I would rather lay in the middle of an interstate than have her as my professor again. Pretty easy class, but she's so strict on the drafts for the semester-long group project and tells you contradicting information. I have now dropped my marketing concentration because of her.
spends too much time talking about personal anecdotes that no one cares about and just never knows what she is talking about.

Dr. Torres is a funny prof and she truly enjoys teaching and marketing overall. Her lectures are interesting to follow and she will offer extra credit for simply answering questions about stuff she alredy went over. However her Blackboard page is a mess and she is not the best at responding to emails. All quizzes are asynchronus and homework easy.

Professor Torres is passionate about marketing, is very knowledgeable about the subject, and is also very funny. Torres has limited office hours and doesn't respond very quickly to emails. Her blackboard site honestly could be for another class. Also her feedback for the final project might have nothing to do with the rubric and can be unclear.

Pretty unclear on instructions and guidelines- her Blackboard schedule was completely different than the syllabus. Uses ChatGPT or McGraw-Hill for all assignments/tests and is really difficult to reach by email. She also doesn't hold office hours which is difficult for group project questions.

The class itself is not difficult, and she is very very fun. However, she gives very strict and harsh feedback for drafts (sometimes takes of points for something she told you to change).  She is also IMPOSSIBLE to reach by email. In class, she is really flexible about opening assignments and letting you turn in work late - just don't ask online.

She is a fun professor. She gives lectures on the slides she makes for her class. There is a In-class midterm quiz, a final quiz, and a group presentation. A total of 10 small quizzes that you need to do online during the whole semester. These things make up your grades. Overall, she is a good professor and really likes to talk.
